name: accordion-module-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the accordion Hugo shortcode module. One offline fixture, built once, covering both authoring surfaces (the paired accordion / accordion-item shortcodes and the public accordion/list.html partial), both output formats (html and the markdown twin), the native <details> markup contract, exclusive-group name minting, deep-link id minting with collision suffixes, and the exact set of warnings the module's degradation contract promises.
